caption: The drawing displays three objects positioned on a plain, beige background. The central and largest object is a brown, metallic, cylindrical lantern with a conical top. This lantern has a handle looped through the apex of the cone and a rectangular door or panel on the front side, secured with a latch. Small rivets or nails are depicted along the top and sides of this lantern. Directly to the right of it is a smaller, detached metallic latch, colored similarly in brown. To the lower left, another lantern is illustrated, rectangular in shape with a glass pane showing diagonal white and gray reflections or patterns. This lantern also has a conical top and a small metallic looped handle, sharing the same brown metallic material as the central object. Handwritten text "HALF ACTUAL SIZE" is placed below the central lantern, and "JAMES VAIL" appears in the lower left corner of the drawing.
title: Lantern
